create_EdgeDegreeEmbedding: create an EdgeDegreeEmbedding module with sphere channels, lmax, mmax, and a radial MLP for edge features
run_EdgeDegreeEmbedding_forward: run the EdgeDegreeEmbedding forward pass with node features, edge features, edge index, and wigner inverse envelope
create_ChgSpinEmbedding: create a ChgSpinEmbedding module with positional, linear, or random embedding for charge or spin values
run_ChgSpinEmbedding_forward: run the ChgSpinEmbedding forward pass to embed charge or spin values using the configured embedding type
create_DatasetEmbedding: create a DatasetEmbedding module with per-dataset embeddings and an optional gradient safety loss during training
